round1Failure.criterion: A pull request opened from a waiting merged root's branch erased the merge it waits on, so the root never closed when its last child left.
round1Failure.resolution: Fixed in cdbe0414b1e5: pullRequestOpened does not record another pull request from the branch of an issue that awaits its merge while its recorded one is merged. The red test TestANewPullRequestFromAWaitingRootsBranchLeavesItsMergeStanding was edited by the implementer: its slots-empty assertion cannot hold inside package workflow, whose rig runs a no-op admission (slots are freed only by admit.releaseDoneSlots, admit.go:695 — I confirmed no slot release exists under internal/workflow). It became the close's own linger_close row, and the slot assertion moved to admit's TestAMergedRootWaitsForItsChildrenAndClosesWhenTheLastLeaves, which runs the real admission. That was a defect in my assertion, not a weakening; accepted. My live run below checks the slot directly.
